description: This file defines an Android activity class 'AuthenticatorActivity' that manages user login/authentication within an Android app. It displays a login screen, handles user input, performs background authentication tasks, and interacts with the Android AccountManager to store account credentials.

classes.name: AuthenticatorActivity
classes.description: An Android activity class that manages user login and account authentication, providing user interface, background authentication tasks, and integration with Android's AccountManager.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the UI, and reads intent data such as username and credential confirmation flag.

methods.name: onCreateDialog
methods.description: Creates and displays a progress dialog during authentication.

methods.name: handleLogin
methods.description: Handles user submitting login credentials; triggers the authentication process.

methods.name: finishConfirmCredentials
methods.description: Completes credential confirmation process, updates AccountManager, and finishes activity.

methods.name: finishLogin
methods.description: Finalizes login by adding/updating account in AccountManager and then finishing activity.

methods.name: onAuthenticationResult
methods.description: Handles authentication response, either proceeding on success or showing error messages.

methods.name: onAuthenticationCancel
methods.description: Handles user cancelling the authentication process.

methods.name: getMessage
methods.description: Provides context-sensitive messages for login prompt.

methods.name: UserLoginTask
methods.description: Inner AsyncTask class that performs the network authentication operation in the background.
